item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Juice WRLD - Studio Sessions Vol 1
item.description:
After sitting on these for a little over a year i decided to finally share them

These mixes where created using the leaked studio sessions files and Pro Tools. Not all the files in Pro Tools match the leaked mp3 files due to the sessions not being final but it's ok i worked with what i had and i' quite happy with the results.

In order to correctly bounce these files i had to scour the internet and get the correct plugins he used when the session was being recorded, and believe me there was a shit ton i had to find.

If there's any Juice WRLD fans here I'm sure you will appreciate these.

I understand why not a lot of people are Re-Bouncing the sessions in lossless because it truly is a pain the ass.

All sessions were bounced at 24bit 44.1/48khz (Depending on the source) and converted to 16bit 44.1 CD quality [Mastered to DR6] (I might release the 24 bit files later on)
